name: Irrational Fear
blurb: Help protect Beckham while he harvests honey.

stages.log_text: I found a Mr. Handy in the Mire talking to himself. I should see if I can find out what he's doing.
I found a Mr. Handy named Beckham who is trying to collect honey, but has a fear of bees. He's asked me to protect him as he harvests the hives in the area.
